description: This file defines a Java class 'ReadableOrderTotalPopulator' which extends 'AbstractDataPopulator' to transform 'OrderTotal' objects into 'ReadableOrderTotal' representations. It handles populating various fields like code, id, module, title, and total, utilizing services like 'PricingService' and utilities like 'LabelUtils' for localization.

classes.name: ReadableOrderTotalPopulator
classes.description: A populator class that converts 'OrderTotal' model objects into 'ReadableOrderTotal' DTOs, adding localized titles and display amounts.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Transforms an 'OrderTotal' source object into a 'ReadableOrderTotal' target, setting fields like code, id, module, order, title, value, and total, using provided services and utilities. Handles exceptions during the process.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Creates a new instance of 'ReadableOrderTotal' as the target data object.

methods.name: getPricingService
methods.description: Returns the current 'PricingService' instance being used.

methods.name: setPricingService
methods.description: Sets the 'PricingService' instance for the populator.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Returns the current 'LabelUtils' instance for message localization.

methods.name: setMessages
methods.description: Sets the 'LabelUtils' instance for message localization.
